title: You Should Care Less About Practical Advice
author: Scott Young
description: Most readers prefer useful advice to abstract theory. They shouldn't. The post You Should Care Less About Practical Advice appeared first on Scott H Young .
summary: After twenty years of writing, I’ve developed a feel for what my audience wants. I don’t always deliver, but I have, at the very least, a strong intuition whether an essay I write is going to have broad appeal, or mostly be read by a handful of fans.
takeaways: Finally, at the trunk, you get to bedrock ideas about learning like the spacing effect or retrieval practice.

A little further down the tree are basic ideas of entrepreneurship like “product-market fit”, “minimum viable product” and “market research.” And towards the base are fundamental concepts like “supply and demand.” Or consider the topic I write most about: effective learning.
If you care about usefulness, spending most of your time learning “advice” or “tips” is counterproductive.
